d:
Nishant kumar ne manch se apne sanbodhan men pradhanmantri narendr modi, mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aur nitish kumar ka jikr kiya. aakhir nishant ne in tinon netaon ko lekar kya kaha aur unke bhashan men kya raha khas? dekhie nishant kumar ke sanbodhan ka yah khas vidiyo.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
